final_verdict.summary: The footage matches a previously published copy (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=95pUW7cTazE, uploaded 2026-08-12), but no claimed event date was given, so recycling relative to the claim is not established. The physical-world check was not available or inconclusive. The claim could not be verified from the available evidence.
limits: A visual match proves shared footage ('previously published'), not that a claim is false or that the footage is fake.
Upload dates are platform metadata (or an archive snapshot date, an upper bound) for the copy found; the earliest copy found is not necessarily the original source.
Search is not exhaustive: memory covers only indexed clips, reverse search rarely finds originals, and heavy crops/edits can evade hash shortlisting.
'Not found' means not found by these adapters, not that no earlier copy exists.
